description: This Java class defines constants and an enum related to guarantors in a loan account context within the Financer application. It includes parameter names used in JSON input for guarantors, error message constants, and a private constructor to prevent instantiation.

classes.name: GuarantorConstants
classes.description: A container for constant values related to guarantors, including parameter names, error codes, and an enum for JSON input parameters.

classes.name: GuarantorJSONinputParams
classes.description: An enum listing all JSON input parameter keys used when creating or updating guarantor information.

methods.name: GuarantorJSONinputParams
methods.description: Constructor for enum constants, assigning string values to each enum entry.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Returns a set of all string values represented by the enum entries.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides default toString to present enum name with underscores replaced by spaces.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value associated with the enum constant.
